$comment: The dashboard clock's control (docs/peps/0005-dashboard-cards.md §4, §4b): the default bar (Rerun's time panel) and five proposals by playback.variant, through one registry (src/registry.js).

views.name: Playback
views.summary: The clock's control: play/pause, step, speed, loop, scrub, a range selection; playback.variant picks a proposal (rerun, rerun-streams, youtube, tracks, foxglove, range) and switcher: true adds a live drop-down. Every time-aware card follows it.
